text:
releaselead-ron: T-minus 45 for the change window start. Quick sweep: canaries, pin state, rollback thresholds. callouts: EU traffic slice + embeddings route.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 3168891280. 5% -> 25% over 3m. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/3168891234 :rocket:
TIA: @releaselead-ron EU slice warmed, preload caches are green. KV hit-rate 98% on stage.
olivia: Confirmed release notes are live in console and support playbook updated with new rollback reasons.
james: Heads up — if latency > 1200ms for >30s on canary, we trigger auto-rollback. Thresholds set in `release.json` under `slo.canary.latency_ms`.
sre-jen: Suggest we hold on pinning v2.3.1 to prod until canary reaches 50% for 10m. Minor schema change might need a quick migration patch.
releaselead-ron: Copy. Set manual pin-until for 20m if metrics look good. Also we need one ops ack before full traffic shift.
TIA: ack from infra side. GPUs at 72% avg, no throttles.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary metrics: error-rate 0.2%, p95 latency 340ms, token throughput nominal. Rolling to 50% now.
james: Running smoke queries against pinned model variant. Sample output looks fine — a couple short truncations but within expected.
sre-jen: I see a subtle 5% increase in tail latency on embeddings route after warmup. I'll keep an eye for 5m window.
olivia: Support checklist: escalation path and RCA template attached in thread. Also pinned the release notes in #support.
releaselead-ron: If embeddings tail holds above baseline for 10m we pause and revert to v2.3.0 for embeddings only, keep LM gen traffic on v2.3.1. Agreed?
james: Agreed. We have a partial rollback playbook ready: `./ops/partial-rollback.md` — will run `deploy rollback --service embeddings --to v2.3.0`.
deply-bot: deploy-bot: (typo) small typo above \u2014 ignoring.
sre-jen: Observation: embeddings p99 moved from 640ms -> 820ms between 3168891345 and 3168891400. That's a 28% jump. Recommend pause at 50%.
releaselead-ron: Pausing traffic shift at 50%. Can anyone confirm no customer-facing errors? @tia @olivia
tia: No customer errors from infra metrics or Sentry.
olivia: No increase in support tickets so far.
james: I can run a narrow A/B test to compare byte-level outputs, pushing a fix in a hot branch if we confirm regression.
releaselead-ron: OK hold. Triage owners: @sre-jen leads perf investigation, @james prepares partial rollback command, @tia handles infra knobs (cache warmers, batching). I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth.
sre-jen: Quick diagnostic: added flamegraph to the embeddings worker, looks like quantized kernel fallback when sequence len spikes. Patching quant config now (ETA 7m).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary paused at 50% by manual hold. Pause reason: embeddings tail latency regression.
releaselead-ron: Thanks. If patch reduces p99 to <700ms within 10m we resume to 100% and then pin. Otherwise execute partial rollback.
james: Patch landed to canary pool, rolling patch to 50% canary nodes now. Command used:
```
opsctl rollout --service embeddings --patch quant-fallback-tweak --pool canary --batch-size 10
```

sre-jen: After patch p99 trending down: 820 -> 680 -> 650 over 6m. Looks promising.
tia: Infra metrics show KV warming stabilized, batching latency reduced by 40ms.
releaselead-ron: Good signal. Resume to 100% over 5m, then do final pin for this release. Keep rollback window open for 30m post-pin.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Resuming rollout to 100% starting now. ETA to 100% ~5m.
james: Monitoring final smoke, running `scripts/smoke_release_checks.sh` now.
sre-jen: Final check p95 320ms, p99 660ms, errors steady.
olivia: Support ready for post-pin watch for 30m. Added extra pager on-call.
releaselead-ron: Pinning v2.3.1 now. Pin command: `deploy pin v2.3.1 --reason "launch-window 3168891234"`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Pin complete. release pinned to v2.3.1.
releaselead-ron: Excellent work team. Postmortem trigger if we see any customer-impacting incident within 24h. Closing thread after 30m of green. :white_check_mark:
